description: Implementation of the Cell_SPM class functions for a battery simulation, including methods for resistance calculation, state setting, voltage computation, and model validation.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: A class representing a specific type of battery cell with methods for state management, voltage calculation, and model validation.

methods.name: getRdc
methods.description: Calculates the total internal resistance of the cell based on surface areas and resistances of components.

methods.name: setSOC
methods.description: Sets the state of charge, optionally checking voltage limits and restoring previous state if out of bounds.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current, checks voltage safety limits, and restores previous state if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: getCSurf
methods.description: Calculates surface concentrations of lithium at particle surfaces.

methods.name: getC
methods.description: Calculates lithium concentrations at Chebyshev nodes within the electrodes.

methods.name: getOCV
methods.description: Computes the open-circuit voltage based on surface concentrations and temperature effects.

methods.name: V
methods.description: Calculates the cell voltage considering surface concentrations, overpotentials, and internal resistance.

methods.name: setTenv
methods.description: Sets the environmental temperature of the cell, checking for valid range.

methods.name: setT
methods.description: Sets the cell temperature and invalidates stress calculations.

methods.name: setC
methods.description: Sets uniform lithium concentrations in electrodes, updating internal states accordingly.

methods.name: checkModelparam
methods.description: Validates model parameters against MATLAB setup matrices to ensure consistency.

methods.name: validStates
methods.description: Checks if the current state variables are within valid physical ranges.
